trigger: On the Steamboat road, if trader_dutch_rep <= -1: Dutch sold your route.

nodes.speaker: wraith
nodes.text: [Freezes in the road. Growls at the culvert ahead.]

nodes.speaker: bridge_boy
nodes.text: Nice cart, airman. Dutch says it's worth a lot. Dutch says you're cheap.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Five of them. Viaduct Crew. Hungry, armed, scared. Somebody sold you for a can of peaches.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: When it's over, two of them are running. One isn't. He was maybe seventeen.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: They take the cans and back off. One of them says, 'Sorry, man. It's Dutch. It's not personal.'

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: Dutch won't see you again. You'll make sure of it.
